quarterly_data.quarter: Tokyo Ohka Kogyo annual securities report: FY2025 (03-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 (Jan-Dec 2025) results, record sales and profit: net sales JPY 237,029 million (+17.9%), operating income JPY 47,386 million (+43.2%), driven mainly by higher sales of high-value-added products centred on materials for leading-edge applications, plus a one-time gain from recognising inventory of development-related materials; net income attributable to owners JPY 33,345 million (+47.0%), including an extraordinary gain on the transfer of the equipment business. By division: Electronic Functional Materials JPY 124.7 billion (+16.0%), High-Purity Chemicals JPY 109.4 billion (+19.6%). Single materials-business segment; production JPY 157,231 million (+16.4%); the company produces to forecast, so it reports no orders received. Sales by region: Taiwan JPY 85,604 million, China JPY 48,611 million, Japan JPY 36,638 million, Korea JPY 30,447 million, US JPY 24,019 million. Management states that in the electronics market smartphone demand was weak while generative-AI-related demand was strong and PC replacement demand was solid; during the year the company made Germany's micro resist technology GmbH a wholly owned subsidiary.
quarterly_data.figure: net sales JPY 237,029 million (+17.9%); operating income JPY 47,386 million (+43.2%); Electronic Functional Materials JPY 124.7 billion (+16.0%); High-Purity Chemicals JPY 109.4 billion (+19.6%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Tokyo Ohka Kogyo annual securities report: FY2025 (03-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: tok Medium-Term Plan 2027 targets for the year ending December 2027 were originally net sales JPY 270.0 billion, operating income JPY 48.0 billion, EBITDA JPY 61.0 billion and ROE 13.0%. On February 9, 2026 the company raised them to net sales JPY 295.0 billion, operating income JPY 58.0 billion, EBITDA JPY 72.0 billion and ROE 14.0%, because sales of its products were running above initial assumptions on expanding generative-AI-related demand in the electronics market and the yen was weaker than its initial assumption. The company aims for the No. 1 global share in advanced photoresists.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2027 targets raised to net sales JPY 295.0 billion, operating income JPY 58.0 billion, EBITDA JPY 72.0 billion, ROE 14.0% (from JPY 270.0 billion / JPY 48.0 billion / JPY 61.0 billion / 13.0%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Tokyo Ohka Kogyo annual securities report: FY2025 (03-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 capital expenditure totalled JPY 28,723 million: mainly the new manufacturing building at the Koriyama plant, plus at TOK Advanced Materials (Korea) a completed inspection building in Incheon and a high-purity chemicals manufacturing building under construction. Planned new facilities: Koriyama plant (Fukushima) electronic functional materials manufacturing building, total JPY 20,000 million (JPY 12,573 million already paid), started July 2024, completion during 2026; TOK Advanced Materials Pyeongtaek plant (Gyeonggi Province, Korea) high-purity chemicals manufacturing building, warehouse and ancillary facilities, total JPY 12,000 million (JPY 3,747 million already paid), started August 2025, completion during 2027. The company does not state the capacity to be added, saying it is difficult to calculate.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2025 capex JPY 28,723 million; Koriyama building JPY 20,000 million, completion during 2026; Pyeongtaek plant JPY 12,000 million, completion during 2027

quarterly_data.quarter: Tokyo Ohka Kogyo annual securities report: FY2025 (03-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D in FY2025: the company focused on developing extreme ultraviolet (EUV) photoresists used in leading-edge semiconductor manufacturing processes and says it won high customer evaluation; it also made steady progress on excimer laser photoresists and high-purity chemicals for advanced patterning, and focused on developing new materials for the semiconductor back-end process. R&D is done at the TOK Technical Innovation Center and at its US, Taiwan and Korea group companies; total R&D expense JPY 15,673 million.
